verdict.rationale: Base44 documents a code-defined managed backend whose resources and code are synced and deployed via the CLI, and it supports third-party AI service integrations via API key. In-app agents can also trigger workflows and connect to tools. However, server-side functions are only implied, and payments and email integrations are not documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of server-side/backend functions authored from the builder, payment provider integration (e.g. a checkout or billing connector), transactional email integration for apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
